name: 上海四年级上册英语 · U1-U4 期中自测（含听力）
edition: 上海教育出版社五·四学制四年级上册；教材版本按手册所述“2026年7月第一版”整理。
description: 26 道固定题：10 道听力选择、8 道语法填空、4 道句型转换和 4 道邀请卡阅读选择，建议 30 分钟完成。
source_note: 原 16 道笔试题依据期中复习手册整理，邀请卡阅读改编为单选；新增 10 道原创听力练习，供 U1-U4 复习自测使用。

knowledge.title: 上海四年级上册英语 U1-U4 知识点梳理
knowledge.intro: 依据复习手册第 2-6 页整理。先复习词汇与核心结构，再用自己的话介绍学校、同学、动物和生日活动。词汇表为重点项，完整默写范围以课本和老师要求为准。

blocks.title: 重点词汇
items: classroom 教室；hall 礼堂、 大厅；computer room 电脑房；school building 校舍。
sports field 运动场；library 图书馆；art room 美术室；reading room 阅览室。
ground floor 底层；bamboo 竹子。

blocks.title: 位置与交际表达
items: in the library / in the reading room：在图书馆 / 阅览室。
on the sports field：在运动场；on the ground floor：在底层。
Where is James? - He is in the reading room.
Shall we meet in the computer room? 我们在电脑房见面好吗？
Let's meet there. 我们在那里见面吧。

blocks.title: 核心语法：have no 与 not have any
items: The reading room has no computers. = The reading room doesn't have any computers.
These buildings have no walls. = These buildings don't have any walls.
he / she / it 等第三人称单数用 has / doesn't have；其他人称用 have / don't have。
doesn't 后的 have 保持动词原形。

blocks.title: 阅读与表达
items: A bamboo school：抓住“竹子建造、像大蘑菇、没有墙”三个特点。
look like 看起来像；be made of bamboo 用竹子制成。
介绍校园场所时按“喜欢哪里 → 在哪里 → 有什么特点 → 在那里做什么”的顺序。
I like the library in my school. It is on the ground floor. It has many books. I read books there.

blocks.title: 重点词汇与短语
items: lovely 可爱的；great 很棒的；interesting 有趣的；friendly 友好的。
different 不同的；polite 有礼貌的；helpful 乐于助人的；classmate 同学。
tell stories 讲故事；clean the blackboard 擦黑板；learn English 学英语。

blocks.title: 三个常用结构
items: help + 人 + 动词原形：He helps me learn English.
be good at + 名词 / 动词-ing：She is good at drawing.
want to be + 职业：He wants to be a painter.

blocks.title: 核心语法：第三人称单数
items: I / we / they：help、tell、want、have。
he / she：helps、tells、wants、has。
He often helps other students learn English. helps 随 he 变化；learn 在“帮助某人做某事”的结构中保持原形。
Does he help his brother? - Yes, he does. 一般疑问句中，Does 后使用动词原形。

blocks.title: 阅读与人物介绍
items: Who's he?：结合人物品质和具体行为来判断人物。
You can do it!：理解 James 遇到的困难，以及同学怎样帮助、鼓励他。
介绍人物时按“性格 → 经常做什么 → 擅长什么 → 理想职业”的顺序。
Lily is friendly and helpful. She often helps me learn English. She is good at drawing. She wants to be a painter.

sections.title: U3 动物及其住所 · Animals and their homes

blocks.title: 重点词汇与短语
items: panda 熊猫；monkey 猴子；elephant 大象；baby elephant 小象；polar bear 北极熊。
hometown 家乡；family 家庭；river 河流；trunk 象鼻；the North Pole 北极。
keep warm 保暖；live in 住在；live near 住在附近；be kind to 友善地对待。

blocks.title: 核心语法：现在进行时
items: 结构：am / is / are + 动词-ing，描述正在发生的动作。
I 用 am；he / she / it 用 is；we / you / they 用 are。
The baby elephant is swimming in the river. The monkeys are playing in the trees.
否定时在 be 后加 not：The monkeys aren't sleeping.
一般疑问句把 be 放在主语前：Is it swimming? - Yes, it is.
对动作提问：What is it doing? / What are they doing?

blocks.title: 动词-ing 的变化
items: 直接加 -ing：play → playing；read → reading。
去掉不发音的 e 再加 -ing：write → writing；make → making。
部分词双写末尾辅音字母再加 -ing：swim → swimming；run → running。

blocks.title: 生活习性与眼前动作
items: Elephants live near water. 描述生活习性。
An elephant is drinking water now. 描述此刻正在发生的动作。
阅读 Polar bears 时关注住所、外形、食物、能力，以及冰雪融化带来的影响。
动物介绍顺序：名称 → 住所 → 外形 → 食物 → 能力。
Polar bears live near the North Pole. They have thick fur. They eat fish and seals. They can swim well.

blocks.title: 重点词汇与短语
items: invitation 请柬；party 聚会；activity 活动；letter 信；noodles 面条；egg 鸡蛋。
share a cake 分享蛋糕；a bowl of noodles 一碗面条；take a family photo 拍全家福。
invite...to... 邀请……参加……；come true 实现；on my birthday 在我生日那天。

blocks.title: 核心语法：介绍传统
items: It's a tradition to + 动词原形，表示“做某事是一种传统”。
It's a tradition to eat a bowl of noodles on my birthday.
It's a tradition to take a family photo on my birthday.
Shall we + 动词原形...?；want to + 动词原形。
Thank you for your help. 谢谢你的帮助。
注意介词搭配：on my birthday；at the birthday party。

blocks.title: 邀请卡阅读：找齐五类信息
items: 对象：谁邀请谁？
Time：几点、哪一天？
Place：在哪里？
Activities：做什么？
Things to bring：需要带什么？

blocks.title: 阅读与表达感谢
items: Letters of love：理解父母的鼓励和孩子的感谢。
A bowl of birthday noodles：理解生日习俗中的亲情。
说生日计划时，要交代清楚地点、活动，以及想为家人做什么。
Thank you for your love. You help me every day. I love you!

sections.title: 易错点速查与复习方法

blocks.title: 语法与词形检查
items: doesn't 后用动词原形：doesn't have，不是 doesn't has。
no 与 not...any 可以表示相同意思：has no books = doesn't have any books。
一般现在时注意主语与动词一致；help + 人后面的动作保持原形。
be good at 后接名词或动词-ing；现在进行时同时检查 be 动词和动词-ing。
注意 swimming、running、writing、making 的拼写。
Shall we 和本册所学的 to 结构后接动词原形。

blocks.title: 搭配与代词检查
items: 位置：in the room；on the ground floor。
生日与聚会：on my birthday；at the party。
parents' letters 表示“父母的信”，注意所有格的撇号位置。
主格、宾格和物主代词要区分：He helps me. / This is his book.

blocks.title: 三轮复习
items: 第一轮：读词汇和短语，再遮住英文，按中文默写。
第二轮：复习核心语法，口头造句，再做句型转换。
第三轮：复述课文，每个主题说或写 4-5 句，再独立完成自测。
语音请配合课本 Sound 栏和音频逐词跟读；注意手册提示的 U1 的 w 与 U3 的 v 发音区别。

blocks.title: 作答后的四项检查
items: 找主语：是单数还是复数？
找时间：是平时如此，还是正在发生？
看结构：助动词、be 动词、动词形式是否匹配？
查书写：句首和人名是否大写、拼写和标点是否正确、单词间是否留空、句子意思是否完整？

blocks.title: 四个单元分别听什么
items: U1：听清学校场所与位置；注意 in / on，以及 has no 表示没有。
U2：听清人物的品质，以及谁帮助谁、帮助做什么；不要把人名和行为配错。
U3：先判断在说哪种动物，再听正在做什么或生活在哪里；注意 is / are 与动词-ing。
U4：邀请卡信息要分清日期或星期、钟点、地点、活动和需要带的物品；不要把聚会活动当成要带的东西。

blocks.title: 先看题，再听两遍
items: 先读问题与选项，明确本题在问地点、人物特点、动作、住所、时间还是物品。
本卷每段录音读两遍，中间间隔约两秒；在线复习可重复播放。
第一遍抓主要信息，第二遍核对细节；特别留意 no / not、不同人物和上午或晚上。
语音跟读仍以课本 Sound 栏与老师要求为准，本套听力重点训练信息提取。

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择 James 现在所在的地方。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择 James 现在所在的地方。
questions.explanation: James 在阅览室读故事；电脑房里的是他的朋友。
questions.listening_text: James is in the reading room. He is reading a story there. His friend is in the computer room.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择阅览室里没有的东西。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择阅览室里没有的东西。
questions.explanation: 录音明确说阅览室有书、桌子和椅子，没有电脑。
questions.listening_text: Our reading room has many books, tables and chairs. It has no computers.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择录音中描述 Ben 的词。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择录音中描述 Ben 的词。
questions.explanation: 录音用 helpful 介绍 Ben，并说他经常帮助别人学英语。
questions.listening_text: Ben is helpful. He often helps me learn English. He helps other children, too.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择 Lily 帮助说话者做的事。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择 Lily 帮助说话者做的事。
questions.explanation: Lily 帮助说话者学英语、读生词，因此选择 Learn English。
questions.listening_text: Lily often helps me learn English. She helps me read new words. I say, "Thank you for your help, Lily."

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择小象正在做的事。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择小象正在做的事。
questions.explanation: 小象正在河里游泳，不是在睡觉。
questions.listening_text: Look at the baby elephant. It is swimming in the river. It is not sleeping.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择猴子正在做的事。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择猴子正在做的事。
questions.explanation: 猴子正在树上玩耍；喝水的是大象，不要混淆动物与动作。
questions.listening_text: The monkeys are playing in the trees. Two elephants are drinking water near the river.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择北极熊的住所。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择北极熊的住所。
questions.explanation: 录音说北极熊生活在北极附近，厚厚的毛可以保暖。
questions.listening_text: Polar bears live near the North Pole. They have thick fur to keep warm.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择生日聚会的时间。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择生日聚会的时间。

options.text: Nine in the evening on Sunday.
Nine in the morning on Sunday.
Eight in the morning on Sunday.
Nine in the morning on Saturday.

questions.explanation: 聚会在星期日早上九点开始，注意钟点、上午或晚上以及星期。
questions.listening_text: Please come to our birthday party in the hall. It starts at nine o'clock on Sunday morning.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择录音中介绍的生日传统。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择录音中介绍的生日传统。
questions.explanation: 录音介绍的生日传统是和家人一起吃一碗面条。
questions.listening_text: On my birthday, it is a tradition to eat a bowl of noodles. I have the noodles with my family. I like this tradition.

questions.prompt: 听录音，选择参加聚会需要带的东西。
questions.chinese: 听录音，选择参加聚会需要带的东西。
questions.explanation: 录音要求带一张生日贺卡；分享蛋糕和拍照是聚会活动。
questions.listening_text: Please bring a birthday card to the party. We can share a cake and take photos together.

questions.prompt:
The reading room ________ (have) no computers.
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: 主语 the reading room 是第三人称单数，表示“有”时用 has。

questions.prompt:
He often ________ (help) me clean the classroom.
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: often 表示经常发生的行为；主语 he 是第三人称单数，所以 help 要加 -s。

questions.prompt:
She is good at ________ (draw).
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: be good at 后接名词或动词-ing，因此 draw 要写成 drawing。

questions.prompt:
The children ________ (be) reading now.
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: children 是复数；现在进行时的结构是 be 动词加动词-ing，这里用 are。

questions.prompt:
Look! The baby elephant ________ (swim) in the river.
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: Look! 提示眼前正在发生的动作；主语是单数，用 is swimming。swim 变为 swimming 时要双写 m。

questions.prompt:
It's a tradition ________ (eat) noodles on my birthday.
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: 固定结构：It's a tradition to + 动词原形。

questions.prompt:
We share a cake ________ my birthday.
从 in / on / at 中选择一个词填空。
questions.explanation: 固定搭配是 on my birthday，表示“在我生日那天”。

questions.prompt:
Shall we ________ (meet) in the library?
按提示填写正确形式。
questions.explanation: Shall we 后接动词原形，所以用 meet。

questions.prompt:
The building has no walls.
改为含 any 的同义句，请填写完整英文句子。
questions.answer: The building doesn't have any walls.
accepted_answers: The building doesn't have any walls.
The building does not have any walls.
questions.explanation: has no 与 doesn't have any 含义相同；doesn't 后用动词原形 have。

questions.prompt:
He helps his brother learn English.
改为一般疑问句，请填写完整英文句子。
questions.answer: Does he help his brother learn English?
accepted_answers: Does he help his brother learn English?
questions.explanation: 主语 he 对应助动词 Does；Does 后的 helps 要还原为 help，learn 保持原形。

questions.prompt:
The monkeys are playing in the trees.
改为否定句，请填写完整英文句子。
questions.answer: The monkeys aren't playing in the trees.
accepted_answers: The monkeys aren't playing in the trees.
The monkeys are not playing in the trees.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时的否定形式是在 be 动词后加 not；are not 可以缩写为 aren't。

questions.prompt:
The baby elephant is swimming.
对“正在做什么”提问，请填写完整英文问句。
questions.answer: What is the baby elephant doing?
accepted_answers: What is the baby elephant doing?
questions.explanation: 对正在发生的动作提问，用 What + be 动词 + 主语 + doing?；the baby elephant 是单数，用 is。

questions.prompt:
阅读邀请卡，选择正确答案。

Dear friends,
Please come to our birthday party.
Time: 9:00 a.m., 8 November
Place: Hall, School Building 2
Activities: Watch a play; share a cake.
Please bring a birthday card.
Class 4A

聚会在什么时间举行？
questions.explanation: 邀请卡的 Time 一栏写着 9:00 a.m., 8 November，即 11 月 8 日上午 9 点。
